title: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners

POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners

['From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>\\nTo: Elaine Chung <elaine@finlytics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@finlytics.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>\\nDate: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700\\nSubject: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners\\n\\nHi Elaine / Rajesh —\\n\\nThanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on POC with us. To make the first week productive, we\'d like to run an \\"opening roundtable\\" where we cover goals, stakeholder roles, prompt review, routing decisions, and the stress/load plan. Proposed agenda (30–45m):\\n\\n- Introductions & success criteria (5m)\\n- Prompt and routing review (10m)\\n- Load test objectives & acceptance criteria (10m)\\n- Owners, calendar blocks, and next steps (5–20m)\\n\\nProposed slots (all PT):\\n- Tuesday 2027-06-22 10:00–10:45\\n- Wednesday 2027-06-23 14:00–14:45\\n- Thursday 2027-06-24 09:00–09:45\\n\\nPlease tell us which of these works or suggest two alternatives. I attached a short starter playbook and a first-pass prompt catalog for review. We\'ll reserve Dedicated capacity for the load run if you confirm the target RPS and concurrency during the roundtable.\\n\\nAttachments: POC-Playbook-v0.3.pdf (21KB stub), prompt-catalog.csv (5KB stub)\\n\\nThanks,\\nSergio Alvarez\\nSolutions Engineer, Redwood Inference\\nsergio@redwood.com\\n\\n---\\n', "From: Elaine Chung <elaine@finlytics.com>\\nTo: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>\\nCc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@finlytics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>\\nDate: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners\\n\\nHi Sergio —\\n\\nThanks for the agenda + materials. We're excited to get going. Quick scheduling note: the 22nd is tight for our CTO (Rajesh) — he can do 23rd at 14:00 PT or 24th at 09:00 PT. Either works for our product and infra leads.\\n\\nAlso: regarding load tests, our initial target is 150 concurrent users with a burst up to 400 requests/min for 15 minutes. We'll confirm exact payload sizes in the roundtable.\\n\\nThanks,\\nElaine Chung\\nDirector, Product — Finlytics\\nelaine@finlytics.com\\n\\n---\\n", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>\\nTo: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>\\nCc: Elaine Chung <elaine@finlytics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@finlytics.com>\\nDate: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners\\n\\nOn Mon, 14 Jun 2027 at 11:18, Elaine Chung <elaine@finlytics.com> wrote:\\n> Thanks for the agenda + materials. We're excited to get going. Quick scheduling note: the 22nd is tight for our CTO (Rajesh) — he can do 23rd at 14:00 PT or 24th at 09:00 PT.\\n\\nThanks Elaine — 23rd 14:00 PT works for our delivery team. Two operational notes for the runbook:\\n\\n1) Capacity reservation — Dylan, can you confirm we can reserve 2x dedicated slots (NVIDIA A100 equivalent) for the stress window (15m burst) and a warmup period of 30m that morning?\\n2) Prompt owners — Camila, can you lead the prompt review and pull a prioritized set of 15 prompts for the session? We'll ask Finlytics to confirm expected token size per call.\\n\\nI'll block the calendar tentatively for 2027-06-23 14:00–15:00 PT and send the invite when resources are confirmed. Sergio, please include the Drive link to the runbook so customers can prep.\\n\\nMarissa Cole\\nEngagement Lead, Redwood Inference\\nmarissa@redwood.com\\n\\nAttachments referenced: none\\n\\n---\\n", "From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>\\nTo: Elaine Chung <elaine@finlytics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@finlytics.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners\\n\\nThanks all — 23rd 14:00 PT is locked. Confirmations:\\n\\n- Dylan: dedicated pool reserved (2x slot warm, 30m warmup, 15m burst) — thanks for the quick turnaround.\\n- Camila: will publish prioritized 15 prompts and a short mapping doc for routing variants by EOD 6/18.\\n- Marissa: you'll own the acceptance criteria doc and post-run checklist.\\n\\nI've created a short pre-read (Drive link below) — please review prompts and the suggested failure-mode checks before the roundtable.\\n\\nCalendar invite will follow with the meeting room and dial-in.\\n\\nDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/POC-Playbook\\nHubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345\\n\\nSergio Alvarez\\nSolutions Engineer, Redwood Inference\\nsergio@redwood.com\\n\\nAttachments: POC-Playbook-v0.3.pdf (updated stub)\\n\\n---\\n", 'From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>\\nTo: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>\\nCc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Elaine Chung <elaine@finlytics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@finlytics.com>\\nDate: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:24:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: POC opening roundtable + stress runbook — schedule & owners\\n\\nGreat — 23rd works for me as well. I\'ll upload the prioritized prompt set and a short mapping (prompt -> routing candidate) by EOD Friday 6/18: prompt-catalog.csv (attached as stub).\\n\\nSmall ask for the Finlytics team: can someone add the expected average token size for each prompt in the CSV column labeled \\"est_tokens\\"? That helps us pick the right quantization/config for accurate latency modeling.\\n\\nThanks,\\nCamila Reyes\\nSolutions Architect, Redwood Inference\\ncamila@redwood.com\\n\\nAttachments: prompt-catalog.csv (5KB stub)\\n\\n---\\n']
